top_signals.title: Supreme Court to Hear Goldman Sachs’ Bankruptcy Arbitration Bid
top_signals.summary: The US Supreme Court agreed to review a request by Goldman Sachs on whether bankruptcy courts can override arbitration agreements, setting up a high-stakes test of the Federal Arbitration Act’s reach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Braskem Shareholders Pull Funding Offer as Debt Talks Hit Snags
top_signals.summary: Talks between Brazil’s Braskem SA and its creditors regarding an out-of-court debt rework have soured, with shareholders taking a proposed capital injection off the table, according to people familiar with the matter.
